# BenjiStack
 
> BenjiStack checks whether people are actually complaining about, and paying to solve, a specific business idea. It pulls real evidence from Reddit, Amazon reviews, and app store reviews instead of generating an AI-guessed score, so founders can see demand signals before building anything.
 
BenjiStack is a free tool for early-stage founders who want to know if a business idea addresses a real, evidenced problem. Unlike AI-scoring validators that estimate viability from a language model's training data, BenjiStack searches live public complaint and review data and reports back what it finds, with counts and sources.
 
## Core pages
 
- [Home](https://benjistack.com/): Check any business idea for real demand signals from Reddit, Amazon, and app store reviews, free, no signup required.
 
## Niche demand pages
 
Each page below checks demand evidence for one common business idea category, pulling real pain points and quotes from Reddit and Quora.
 
- [Is dropshipping worth it in 2026?](https://benjistack.com/ideas/dropshipping-worth-it-2026.html): Real complaints on traffic, suppliers, and niche selection for beginner dropshippers.
- [Is print on demand worth it in 2026?](https://benjistack.com/ideas/print-on-demand-worth-it-2026.html): Real complaints on market saturation, niche selection, and thin margins for POD sellers.
- [Is a vending machine business worth it in 2026?](https://benjistack.com/ideas/vending-machine-business-worth-it-2026.html): Real complaints on securing locations, upfront costs, and declining profitability for vending operators.
- [Is an online coaching business worth it in 2026?](https://benjistack.com/ideas/online-coaching-business-worth-it-2026.html): Real complaints on market saturation, client retention, and building a client pipeline for online coaches.
 
## About
 
BenjiStack exists to stop people from building things nobody's complaining about. The positioning: don't sell your passion, solve a problem people will pay for.
